subject: Q3 checkpoint: scope triage, infra gating, and action-owner asks
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: jane.dobson@acmecorp.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 checkpoint: scope triage, infra gating, and action-owner asks

Team — kicking off a short mid-quarter checkpoint with a focus on narrowing scope and clearing infra gates so we can preserve throughput on the delivery roadmap. I attached a one-page snapshot and an infra impact matrix for quick context. TL;DR: two OKRs need immediate triage (time-sensitive), one depends on infra quota/security signoff.

Current snapshot (see attached Q3_okr_snapshot_v2.pdf):
- OKR-1 (Model latency & cost): Green. On track; running last two experiments with batching changes.
- OKR-2 (Streaming + tool integrations): At risk. Feature set is broader than we can deliver given current infra gating; recommended re-scope to "core streaming + 2 tool connectors" rather than 5.
- OKR-3 (Deduped embeddings + indexing stability): Yellow. Needs one additional infra rollout window to stabilize index-merge paths.

Immediate asks: (please respond by EOD Tue 21 Jul)
1) Infra gating: Aditya — confirm GPU quota and network egress approvals for the staging cluster; we need a signed change ticket and RBAC review before the rollout window (target: 2026-07-26). See infra-impact-matrix.xlsx.
2) Product scope decision: Laura/Kim — pick the minimal tranche of tool connectors to retain for OKR-2 if infra can't unblock by Tue. Propose: Slack + Webhook as minimal viable.
3) Eval & rollout: Kim — confirm test harnesses we’ll run post-rollout and the SLO regression checklist.
4) Customer comms: Jane/Acme — if we have to shift one integration out of initial scope, what is the acceptable communication timeline to customers on pilot?

Proposed short triage sync: 30 min, Tue 21 Jul 11:00–11:30 PT (meet link below). If that time doesn't work, add your availability to the calendar.

Attachments: Q3_okr_snapshot_v2.pdf, infra-impact-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Vanessa — thanks for the crisp summary and the artifacts. Quick responses inline: 

- OKR-2 scope: I agree we should aim to land a narrower tranche. Proposal: keep Streaming core + Slack connector + Webhook. Defer Salesforce and Figma connectors to the next split (Q3->Q4 carry).
- Metrics question: is the "deliverable" for OKR-2 the connector end-to-end demo to pilot customers or is it an internal smoke test? I suggest we keep the pilot demo as the success metric (customer-visible).

I can reassign two engineers from the integrations backlog to the triage work for a week starting 7/22 if infra can sign off on the staging cluster by 7/26. If infra is delayed, we will prioritize the smoke tests that we can run locally (no dependent cluster).

Adding my quick notes to the doc (see Drive link).

Laura

Vanessa / team — short infra update and gating items: 

- Quota: We have a pending request for +2 GPU quota in us-west-2 for the staging pool; cloud team estimates approval in ~72 hours after ticket submission. I opened CHG-3421 and attached the ticket screenshot (infra_ticket_screenshot.png).
- Security/RBAC: Need the security questionnaire completed for any external connector that touches customer data. Jane — can you share Acme's SOC2 summary or equivalency? That will speed the compliance signoff.
- Network/Egress: There are one-time egress rules needed for the webhook pilot; this requires change window coordination with Networking (prefer early morning window).
- Risk: If quota is delayed past 7/26, we can run a reduced smoke rollout purely on local infra but it will not match production latency profiles.

Action items assigned: 
- Aditya: push CHG-3421 and confirm approval by 7/22 (I’ll chase with Cloud ops).
- Kim: provide the list of endpoints that require egress rules by EOD Mon 7/20.

Thanks everyone — summary and confirmed actions after today's threads/calls. Please treat this as the source of truth for owners and deadlines.

- OKR-2 will be re-scoped to: Streaming core + Slack + Webhook connectors (Salesforce & Figma deferred to Q4).
- Rollout approach: staging rollout targeted for 7/26 if CHG-3421 approves quota; otherwise run reduced local smoke tests on 7/26 and stagger full staging rollout to earliest available window.

Confirmed owners & deadlines:
- Aditya Rao: push CHG-3421; confirm GPU quota and Network egress approval by 2026-07-22 EOD. (If not approved, notify Vanessa and Laura immediately.)
- Kimberly Park: deliver endpoint list for egress rules and SLO regression checklist by 2026-07-20 EOD.
- Laura Bennett: reassign two engineers to integrations for week of 2026-07-22 and prepare pilot demo plan by 2026-07-23.
- Jane Dobson (Acme): provided SOC2 summary; security team available for a 15-min review. Please coordinate directly with Aditya if needed.

Next steps & meetings:
- Triage sync: Tue 21 Jul 11:00–11:30 PT — join: https://meet.example.com/vanessa-okr-triage-30
- If infra quota is approved early, we’ll add an optional readiness check on Fri 24 Jul 09:00 PT.
